tagline: From Vision to Structure, From Students to Engineers.
about: The Civil Engineering Students Society, known as CESS, is a non-profit organization within the Department of Civil Engineering at NIT Arunachal Pradesh. Its members include undergraduate and postgraduate students, faculty and alumni.
CESS gives students a platform to show and sharpen their talents through events and activities planned across the year.

pillars.title: Technical events
pillars.text: Seminars, workshops and guest lectures by industry experts.

pillars.title: Innovation
pillars.text: Forums for creative thinking, debate and ideas.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.text: One platform for students, faculty and alumni.

objectives.title: Professional readiness
objectives.text: Expose future civil engineers to the challenges of the profession and keep them informed about current trends.

objectives.title: Continuous learning
objectives.text: Involve students in guest lectures, seminars and industrial visits through the academic year.

objectives.title: Innovation culture
objectives.text: Encourage every student to share ideas through meetings, discussions, debates and seminars.

events.title: Ideathon 1.0
events.text: Students pitched ideas to a panel. Winners were felicitated by the Director and the Dean (SA).

events.title: Ideathon 2.0
events.text: A second round of the ideas competition, with judges evaluating each proposal.

events.title: Bridge Making Competition
events.text: Teams built model bridges. The Most Aesthetic Bridge was recognised.

events.title: Water Filter Event
events.text: Faculty and coordinators hosted a hands-on water filter activity.

events.title: Guest lectures and seminars
events.text: Experts from institutes and industry speak to students, including Dr. Rishikesh Bharti of IIT Guwahati.

events.title: Industrial visits
events.text: Site tours that connect classroom learning to real projects.

messages.name: Prof. Mohan V Aware
messages.title: Director's message
text: NIT Arunachal Pradesh has proved to be one of the best institutions in North East India, with strong academics and a research environment on cutting-edge topics.
I congratulate the entire team of the NITAP Civil Engineering Student Society for creating a platform to share the positive changes happening on campus.
messages.sign: With a eupeptic heart, I wish my best to the Civil Engineering Student Society.

messages.name: Dr. Mainak Mallik
messages.title: HOD's message
text: Greetings from the Civil Engineering Student Society.
I urge each of you to forge ahead in achieving your dreams with all your might, and to come together as one to reach greater heights in your careers.
messages.sign: Warm regards, HOD, Dept. of CE.

messages.name: Dr. Jayakesh K
messages.title: Advisor's message
text: It is an honor to be part of this initiative. CESS explores the unseen talent in students and keeps them abreast of modern trends in civil engineering.
Your participation and contribution to CESS are always welcome.
messages.sign: One platform, One CESS and many opportunities.

messages.name: Kaling Yapi
messages.title: President's message
text: This is your platform, built on innovation, collaboration and excellence, where ideas meet opportunities.
CESS bridges the gap between academic knowledge and practical exposure through events, workshops and competitions.
